optimizedDescription.value: ArchiveChange atomically preflights, publishes, archives, restores on commit failure, then reports nonfatal post-archive failures.

optimizedContext.value:
# ArchiveChange

## Rules
- Inject repositories, schema/parser/extractor registries, `archiveBindings`, reconciler, `MaterializeSpecMetadata`, actor, batch snapshot, hashing; never `RunStepHooks`/`HookRunner`.
- `execute({ name, skipChecks })`: skip list defaults empty; only resolved skippable check IDs accepted. Aliases map to checks. Never bypass unrelated checks.
- Accept only `archivable|archiving`; run archive predicates before hooks/snapshots: schema, archivable, overlap, workspace/deps, implementation, verification. Reconcile fresh facts after pre-effects; committed recovery remains persisted.
- Use bindings for pre/post effects; skip phases never skips predicates. Pre failure aborts unchanged. Read-only or failed predicates: no hooks/writes.
- Fully prepare merged artifacts, dependencies, persisted state, locks, implementation links, and all validations before canonical writes. Snapshot whole batch; transition `archivable→archiving` immediately before first publish.
- Commit failure restores all snapshots; return `archivable` only after complete restore. Orphan matching backup restores then aborts; foreign/unreadable backup aborts.
- Publish via `SpecRepository.publish({ persistedState, expectedRevision })`; preserve optimizations. Archive through `archiveRepository.archive(change,{ actor })`; metadata/post-effects failures are nonfatal results.
- On bypassed `spec.overlap`, reconcile each peer with `spec-overlap-conflict`; never `change.invalidate()`.

## Constraints
- No hooks, snapshots, or writes before `change.assertArchivable()`.
- Preflight and snapshots precede `archiving` and first publication.
- Successful archive never rolls back for metadata/post-effect failure.
